structuralReviews.decision: Keep composed primitives: each profile selects a different target (closest, behind, or rule-specific), so a callback wrapper would add indirection without a shared invariant.
Keep composed primitives: classification and post-draw behavior differ; the shared draw/give/discard operations are already provided by the Cards kit.
